source_type: reused existing calculation core plus explicitly identified recovered context/accessory adapter
current_core: Unchanged V1.16.7 / source-locked V1.13 files; strict existing holds and proposed estimates retained.

historical_source.access: Read/search text from the File Library. Raw-byte materialization unavailable; no claim to a byte-identical full-source export.

new_adapter_boundaries: No historical whole app, catalogue, old avatar or legacy score engine is installed.
Current canonical primary/accent/pattern metadata replaces brittle historical name-based condition lookups in the accessory adapter. These are contextual rule inferences, not edits to wardrobe DNA.

Shoe and watch preference coefficients are transcribed from the named historical composites. Missing-dimension neutral placeholders are disclosed in accessory detail. They are not mixed into the clothing score.
Shoes are selected after a clothing configuration; watch last. Best qualifying accessories are chosen for each clothing tuple. Accessory-only variations do not pad 15 clothing options.

Weather uses recovered Phase 9 weights, penalties, material classes, existing season eligibility and the historical minimum weather-domain score 7. It is separately disclosed from fixed compatibility.
Only explicit current material words are used. Resemblance (e.g. boucle-like) stays unknown; suede elbow trim is not called an all-suede body. No new fibre or measured traction field is assigned.
Snow/ice dress-shoe exclusion is the inherited category proxy, not proof of a particular sole or a safety certification.
Known freezing precipitation codes are mapped to snow/ice; missing units/values and unknown codes fail to manual fallback.
No Foxborough or other hardcoded historical location is used. Device coordinates are permission-based; city results require selection.
The original near-equivalent band and confirmed-wear rotation policy remain unchanged. Accessory ties use prior confirmed last wear, then stable physical ID, not random selection.

weather_api.coordinates: rounded to 0.01 degree before provider request
weather_api.privacy: explicit user request only; credentials omitted and referrer suppressed; separate local weather key, not wear or Favorites

new_acceleration_cache.meaning: 112392 unchanged engine outputs across 102 topwear/profile groups; not new score judgments
new_acceleration_cache.core_result_verification: tests/core-workflow.cjs compares every row to independent V1.16.7 and current core results
